advisories.title: DSA-6598-1 thunderbird - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues were discovered in Thunderbird, which could result in the execution of arbitrary code or information disclosure

advisories.title: DSA-6597-1 dpdk - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in DPDK, a set of libraries for fast packet processing. Depending on enabled functionality, crafted packets or malicious guest requests could cause denial of service or memory corruption.

advisories.title: DSA-6596-1 wordpress - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in wordpress, a web blogging tool, which could result in denial of service, cross-site scripting, SQL injection, information disclosure, privilege escalation or remote code execution.

advisories.title: DSA-6595-1 tor - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities were discovered in Tor, a connection- based low-latency anonymous communication system, would could result in denial of service.

advisories.title: DSA-6594-1 python-git - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues were discovered in GitPython, a Python library to interact with Git repositories, which could result in information disclosure, directory traversal, execution of arbitrary code or denial of service.

advisories.title: DSA-6593-1 imagemagick - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities were discovered in imagemagick, a software suite used for editing and manipulating digital images, which could lead to denial of service, information disclosure or potentially arbitrary code execution if malformed images are processed.

advisories.title: DSA-6592-1 chromium - security update
advisories.summary: Security issues were discovered in Chromium which could result in the execution of arbitrary code, denial of service, or information disclosure.

advisories.title: DSA-6591-1 openjdk-25 - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities have been discovered in the OpenJDK Java runtime, which may result in denial of service, sandbox breakout, incomplete certificate checks or information disclosure.

advisories.title: DSA-6590-1 firefox-esr - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues have been found in the Mozilla Firefox web browser, which could potentially result in the execution of arbitrary code, sandbox escape, bypass of the same-origin policy, privilege escalation, information disclosure or spoofing.

advisories.title: DSA-6585-2 thunderbird - regression update
advisories.summary: The update for thunderbird in DSA-6585-1 introduced a regression in the supported for PGP-encrypted emails. Updated packages are now available to correct this issue.

advisories.title: DSA-6589-1 php-mongodb - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been discovered in the MongoDB driver for PHP, which could result in denial of service.

advisories.title: DSA-6588-1 openjdk-21 - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities have been discovered in the OpenJDK Java runtime, which may result in denial of service, sandbox bypass, incomplete certificate checks or information disclosure.

advisories.title: DSA-6587-1 pdns - security update
advisories.summary: It was discovered that incorrect parsing of packets with compression pointers in the PowerDNS DNS server could result in denial of service.

advisories.title: DSA-6586-1 valkey - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in Valkey, an in-memory key-value database. These issues could cause denial of service and, in some cases, potentially allow arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: DSA-6585-1 thunderbird - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues were discovered in Thunderbird, which could result in the execution of arbitrary code or information disclosure Debian follows the Thunderbird upstream releases. Support for the 140.x series has ended, so starting with this update we're now following the 153.x series.

advisories.title: DSA-6584-1 varnish - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in Varnish Cache, an HTTP accelerator, which could result in cache poisoning, authentication bypass or denial of service. CVE-2026-34475 Tom Kinnaird discovered a deficiency in the parsing of HTTP/1.1 absolute-form request targets.

advisories.title: DSA-6583-1 libheif - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security issues were discovered in libheif, a library for reading and writing HEIF and AVIF images. Processing specially crafted images could result in denial of service through excessive resource consumption or crashes, or disclosure of process memory.

advisories.title: DSA-6582-1 brotli - security update
advisories.summary: A vulnerability was discovered in Brotli, a generic-purpose lossless compression suite, which could result in denial of service, or potentially the execution of arbitrary code.

advisories.title: DSA-6581-1 unbound - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities were discovered in Unbound, a validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver. CVE-2026-35501 (DNSSEC) Bypass of a configured island trust anchor underneath an insecure parent from an attacker-controlled NSEC record.

advisories.title: DSA-6580-1 erlang - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in Erlang/OTP, a programming language and runtime environment. These issues could result in denial of service, HTTP request smuggling, or bypass of authentication and access restrictions, including TLS server impersonation.

advisories.title: DSA-6579-1 roundcube - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities were discovered in roundcube, a skinnable AJAX based webmail solution for IMAP servers, which could result in IMAP command injection, cross-site scripting, SSRF bypass, email header injection, css property injection, remote content blocking bypass, information disclosure…

advisories.title: DSA-6578-1 aide - security update
advisories.summary: Two vulnerabilities were discovered in aide, an advanced intrusion detection system, which could allow a local user to bypass the detection of malicious files.

advisories.title: DSA-6577-1 chromium - security update
advisories.summary: Security issues were discovered in Chromium which could result in the execution of arbitrary code, denial of service, or information disclosure.

advisories.title: DSA-6534-3 webkit2gtk - regression update
advisories.summary: The webkit2gtk update released as DSA-6534-1 introduced a regression that prevents Evolution from displaying images embedded in HTML emails.

advisories.title: DSA-6576-1 bind9 - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in BIND, a DNS server implementation, which could result in denial of service or remote code execution.

advisories.title: DSA-6575-1 nginx - security update
advisories.summary: Several vulnerabilities were discovered in nginx, a high performance web and reverse proxy server. Depending on the configuration, these could result in memory corruption, denial of service, injection of requests to backend servers, or bypass of client certificate authentication.

advisories.title: DSA-6574-1 php8.4 - security update
advisories.summary: It was discovered that incorrect memory state tracking in PHP, a widely-used open source general purpose scripting language, could result in the execution of arbitrary code.

advisories.title: DSA-6573-1 firefox-esr - security update
advisories.summary: This update blocks compromised intermediate certificates issued by the eMudhra CA. Most users will have these certs already blocked by the OneCRL feature provided by Firefox.

advisories.title: DSA-6572-1 ca-certificates - security update
advisories.summary: It was discovered that several eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. Updated ca-certificate packages are provided to remove the "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" and "Comodo AAA Services root" certificates.

advisories.title: DSA-6571-1 xen - security update
advisories.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in the Xen hypervisor, which could result in privilege escalation, information disclosure or denial of service.
